analyst.summary: Bajaj Holdings & Investment is not an operating company - it is a holding vehicle whose assets are large stakes in Bajaj Auto (~37%) and Bajaj Finserv (~42%), a small stake in Maharashtra Scooters, a newly acquired direct stake in the Bajaj group's two insurance companies (bought out from Allianz earlier this year), and a treasury investment book. Its own market value currently sits at roughly half of what those stakes are worth added together - a discount that appears to have widened recently rather than narrowed, with no signaled plan to close it via a buyback or restructuring. The underlying businesses are performing well and the company pays a generous, consistent dividend (Rs.195/share for FY26, including a one-time centenary bonus), but with no catalyst to unlock the value gap, we rate it a Hold.
